description: Weather forecasts from the Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) operated by NOAA NWS NCEP.

links.title: NOAA GEFS forecast, 35 day, 0.5 degree, virtual

attribution: NOAA NWS NCEP GEFS data processed by dynamical.org from NOAA Open Data Dissemination archives.
description_summary:
This dataset is an archive of past and present GEFS forecasts at 0.5 degree resolution, optimized for spatial (map) access patterns. Forecasts are identified by an initialization time (`init_time`) denoting the start time of the model run as well as by the `ensemble_member`, and step forward along the `lead_time` dimension 3 hourly to 10 days and 6 hourly to 35 days. This dataset contains only the 00 hour UTC initialization times, which produce the full length 35 day forecast.

Variables on pressure levels, model levels and fixed heights above mean sea level live in the `pressure_level`, `model_level` and `height_above_mean_sea_level` groups.

Note: `dynamical-catalog>=0.8.0` (or `zarr>=3.2 icechunk>=2.0 gribberish>=1.5`) is required.
description_details:
### Source

The source grib files this archive is constructed from are provided by
[NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD)](https://www.noaa.gov/information-technology/open-data-dissemination)
and accessed from the [AWS Open Data Registry](https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-gefs/).

### Data availability

NOAA NCEP publishes the first 16 days of each forecast as a continuous stream; the remaining
days out to 35 arrive more slowly and finish about 27 hours after initialization, so the newest
initialization time is usually still filling.

### Storage

Storage for this dataset is generously provided by [AWS Open Data](https://aws.amazon.com/opendata/).

### Chunks

This dataset is stored in [Zarr](https://zarr.dev/) format, which splits each variable into a grid of **chunks** — the smallest unit read from storage. When possible, aligning your reads with this dataset's chunk grid can significantly improve data access speed.

The element count and coordinate span of this dataset:

| dimension | chunk |
|---|---|
| init_time | 1 (1 day) |
| ensemble_member | 1 |
| lead_time | 1 (~3 hours) |
| latitude | 361 (180.5°) |
| longitude | 720 (360°) |
| **uncompressed** | 2.0 MiB |

### Validation report

Review the [validation report](https://dynamical.org/catalog/noaa-gefs-forecast-35-day-0-5-degree-virtual/validation/) for variable availability, missing data, known quirks, fill values, value distributions, and sample plots.
description_model: The Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) is a National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) weather forecast model. GEFS creates 31 separate forecasts (ensemble members) to describe the range of forecast uncertainty.

variants.label: dynamical-catalog
variants.code:
import dynamical_catalog  # dynamical-catalog>=0.8.0

ds = dynamical_catalog.open("noaa-gefs-forecast-35-day-0-5-degree-virtual", group="pressure_level", chunks=None)
ds["geopotential_height"].sel(init_time="2025-01-01T00", lead_time="240h", pressure_level=500).mean("ensemble_member")

variants.label: pystac + icechunk
variants.code:
import icechunk
import pystac
import xarray as xr

catalog = pystac.Catalog.from_file("https://stac-staging.dynamical.org/catalog.json")
collection = catalog.get_child("noaa-gefs-forecast-35-day-0-5-degree-virtual")
asset = collection.assets["icechunk-https"]

authorize = icechunk.containers_credentials({"s3://noaa-gefs-pds/": icechunk.s3_anonymous_credentials()})
repo = icechunk.Repository.open(
    icechunk.http_storage(asset.href),
    authorize_virtual_chunk_access=authorize,
)
session = repo.readonly_session("main")

ds = xr.open_zarr(session.store, group="pressure_level", chunks=None)
ds["geopotential_height"].sel(init_time="2025-01-01T00", lead_time="240h", pressure_level=500).mean("ensemble_member")
